args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` for the `quantize` call.

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on `fix-bankers-rounding-fin212` (sha 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Approver needed: code owner (main is protected).
